newsitem.title: USA: Harnischfeger says Giddings meeting set for Sept 5.
newsitem.headline: Harnischfeger says Giddings meeting set for Sept 5.

text.p: Harnischfeger Industries Inc said Tuesday a special meeting of Giddings & Lewis Inc shareholders, which Harnischfeger is seeking as part of its hostile bid for Giddings, must be held on September 5.
Harnischfeger said the meeting would be called to, among other things, remove and replace Giddings' current board of directors.
Harnischfeger, which has launched a $19 a share hostile bid for Giddings, based the September 5 date for the special shareholders meeting on its reading of the Giddings bylaws.
Giddings officials were not immediately available.

In late May, Harnischfeger delivered to Giddings written demands to call a special meeting of Giddings shareholders. Harnischfeger said that, based on Giddings' bylaws, the delivery date for making the written request for the meeting would be no later than May 30.

Harnischfeger also claimed that Giddings' failed to set a date for the special meeting within 10 days of the delivery date, or June 9. As a result, Harnischfeger said, the meeting must now be held 100 days after the delivery date or on the preceding business day, which would be Friday, September 5.
Harnischfeger also said that, under Giddings' bylaws, the record date for shareholders for the special meeting must be between June 27 and June 29.
In a letter to Giddings, K. Thor Lundgren, general counsel for Harnischfeger, asked Giddings to advise shareholders on the scheduling of the special meeting.
